resource_preflight.planning_method: Actual world triangles, discard disjoint triangle AABBs, retain full area of crossing triangles. Projected area times density squared estimates raster surface count. Six times main-buffer storage allows approximately2x count uncertainty and3x total-buffer work; not a hard upper bound or measured peak.
